name: 赤峰街口
why: phase 3 = 赤峰街 green; people cross 南京西路. min_clear = yellow 3 + all-red 3

lamp.why: the 南京西路 lamp at 赤峰街 turns red 2 s before people may cross and stays red through phases 1 and 3
the 南京西路 lamp at 25 巷 turns red at the start of the 7 s all-red that ends phase 1, i.e. 7 s before the pedestrian phase

name: 承德路口
full: 承德路一段 × 南京西路
why: two crossings at this junction. 橫越承德路 runs with 南京西路 green: phase 3 in the 4-phase night plans, phase 5 in the 6-phase plans (camera-checked). 橫越南京西路 runs with 承德路 green: phase 1 / phase 2

lamp.why: the 南京西路 lamp at 承德路 turns green when people may start crossing 承德路 (first option); observed green is about 9 s shorter than the phase; its switch-on time is read less steadily than the red lamps, so a wider spread is accepted
